title: Base Read Command variant 6
purpose: Vary a meaningful pair of fields in a plausible read-style information transfer frame while preserving likely structural relationships and internal length consistency.
expected_behavior: A plausible read command frame is parsed as a complete application data unit with stable control bytes and mutable type, qualifier, common address, and information object address fields.
constraints_preserved: Prefer widely recognized FT1.2 or IEC 60870-5-104 APCI framing.
Keep 0x68 length octets consistent with the selected frame size.
Diversify link control, interrogation, command and measurement paths.
issue_safety_notes: No external protocol documents or vulnerability issue reports were used. This seed is based only on internal prior knowledge and built-in constraints.
